items.title: Filtration (print mein doosra 15.1) (chhaan kar alag karna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Filtration, printed as a second 15.1 with Figures 15.1 to 15.4 and Quick Check 15.1, pages 324-326.

blocks.text: Yeh process do components wale heterogeneous mixture (aisa mixture jis ke hisse alag alag nazar aayen) mein se ek component ko alag karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Pehla step suitable (munasib) solvent chunna hai, jis mein ek component poori tarah hal ho jaye aur doosra taqreeban bilkul hal na ho. Misal ke taur par aam namak (common salt) aur ret (sand) ka mixture lein.

Is mixture ko distilled water mein dalein. Namak poore pani mein phail kar homogeneous mixture (har jagah ek jaisa mixture) bana deta hai. Is homogeneous mixture ko pani mein namak ka solution kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Ek haath tirchhe beaker se mixture glass rod (sheeshe ki dandi) ke saath filter paper wale funnel mein dal raha hai; funnel stand ke clamp mein hai aur neeche beaker mein filtrate ke qatre gir rahe hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.1: Filtration ka process (kitab ki Figure 15.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki is picture par koi label nahi. Mixture ko seedha funnel mein nahi dalte balkay glass rod ke saath aahista dalte hain taake chhinte na urein. Funnel stand ke clamp mein laga hai; filter paper par ret (residue) ruk jati hai aur namak ka solution (filtrate) neeche beaker mein chala jata hai.

Is solution mein namak ko solute aur pani ko solvent kehte hain. Solution mein solvent woh component hai jo solute ke muqable mein zyada amount mein ho. Namak to pani mein ghaib ho jata hai, lekin doosra component, ret, hal nahi hoti aur kuch der baad solution ke bottom (tah) mein beth jati hai.

Upar wale solution se ret alag karne ke liye filtration istemal hoti hai. Yeh kai type ke filter media (filter karne wali cheezon) se ki ja sakti hai. Precipitate (solid particles) ki nature aur doosri baaton se tay hota hai ke kaun sa filter medium lena hai. Sab se aasan tareeqe do hain: filter paper se, ya filter crucible se.
a) Filter paper se filtration
Filter paper ko sahi tarah morna (fold karna) zaroori hai, aur yeh do tareeqon se hota hai.

1. Glass funnel aur filter paper se filtration aam taur par aahista hoti hai. Jab mixture filter paper par dala jata hai to solvent (pani) guzar jata hai aur suspended particles (pani mein tairte zarre) paper par reh jate hain. Filter papers different (alag alag) porosity (pore size, yani soorakhon ka size) mein milte hain. Kaun sa pore size lena hai, yeh precipitate ke particles ke size par depend karta hai. Filter paper itna bara ho ke filtration ke aakhir mein woh ek chauthai (one-fourth) se aadha (one-half) precipitate se bhara ho. Is tarah filtrate chhinte urae baghair beaker ki deewar ke saath neeche utarta hai. Poora filtration assembly Figure 15.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Teen drawings: gol filter paper jis ke beech dashed lakeer (pehla mor), aadha daira jis par aari dashed lakeer (doosra mor), aur paper ko khol kar bana cone.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2a: Filter paper ko morna (folding) (kitab ki Figure 15.2a ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Mora hua filter paper phir 60-degree funnel mein rakha jata hai, pani se geela kiya jata hai aur zor se daba diya jata hai.

2. Conical funnel se filtration ki speed Fluted Filter Paper se kafi barh jati hai. Is ke liye aam filter paper ko is tarah mora jata hai ke pankhe (fan) jaisi shakal ban jaye, jis mein bari bari ubhar (elevations) aur gehrai (depressions) hon, Fig 15.2 b.

blocks.alt: Saat steps: filter disk; aadha morein; phir aadha morein; chauthai hisse ki silwat; aathwein hisse ki silwat; pankhe jaisi accordion shakal; khula filter cone.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2b: Fluted (silwaton wala) filter paper (kitab ki Figure 15.2b ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer ki direction dekhein: oopar ki line baayen se daayen, phir neeche aa kar daayen se baayen. Har mor par kaghaz par nayi crease (silwat) banti hai; aakhir mein kaghaz pankhe ki tarah ubhar aur gehrai wala ho jata hai. Is se funnel aur kaghaz ke beech hawa ka raasta rehta hai aur filtration tez hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki caption mein 'Fluttled filter paper' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Fluted' (silwaton wala) hai.
Filtration ke baad funnel ke neeche conical flask mein jo liquid jama hota hai use filtrate kehte hain. Funnel par jo ret bach jati hai use residue kehte hain.
b) Crucible se filtration
Precipitate ko filter karne ka ek aur aasan tareeqa crucible ke zariye suction (hawa kheench kar) se hai. Aam taur par do type ke crucibles istemal hote hain.

1. Gooch crucible porcelain ka bana hota hai. Is ka bottom perforated (soorakhon wala) hota hai, jise paper pulp ya us ke size ka kata hua filter paper dhakta hai, Figure 15.3. Ise suction filtering apparatus mein rakh kar jaldi filtration ho jati hai. Yeh un precipitates ke liye useful (faidemand) hai jinhen bohat zyada temperature par garam (ignite) karna ho. Agar is ke soorakh asbestos mat se dhak diye jayen to is se woh solutions bhi filter ho sakte hain jo kaghaz se react karte hain, jaise concentrated HCl aur KMnO₄ ke solutions.

blocks.alt: Safed porcelain ka crucible ulta rakha hai taake us ka perforated bottom (soorakhon wala pendaa) nazar aaye; paas ek alag soorakhon wali disc aur ek gol plate.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.3: Gooch crucible (kitab ki Figure 15.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Glass ka crucible jis ke neeche ke hisse mein safed porous (bareek soorakhon wali) glass disc lagi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: Sintered glass crucible (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai aur us ke bottom ke soorakhon par paper pulp ya filter paper rakhna parta hai. Sintered glass crucible mein porous (soorakhon wali) glass disc pehle se lagi hoti hai, is liye koi tayyari nahi chahiye. Dono suction (vacuum) ke saath istemal hote hain.

2. Sintered glass crucible glass ka crucible hai jis ke bottom mein porous glass disc sealed (pakki jari) hoti hai. Ise istemal karna bohat aasan hai kyun ke Gooch crucible ki tarah koi tayyari nahi karni parti, Figure 15.4.

blocks.text: Quick Check 15.1

blocks.prompt: a) Filtration mein istemal hone wale different filter media ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Saada filter paper (cone), fluted filter paper, Gooch crucible (paper pulp, filter paper ya asbestos mat ke saath) aur sintered glass crucible.

blocks.prompt: b) Filtration process ke components kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Mixture, filter medium (paper ya crucible) wala funnel ya crucible, aur neeche flask. Filtration ke baad do cheezen milti hain: filtrate (jo liquid guzar gaya) aur residue (jo solid filter par reh gaya).

blocks.prompt: c) Gravity filtration aur vacuum filtration mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Gravity filtration mein liquid apne wazan se filter paper ke cone se guzarta hai; yeh aahista hai. Vacuum filtration mein suction (pump) liquid ko crucible ya filter se kheenchta hai; yeh tez hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Gooch aur sintered glass crucible mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Gooch crucible porcelain ka hai; us ke soorakhon ko istemal se pehle paper pulp, filter paper ya asbestos mat se dhakna parta hai, aur ise tez garam kiya ja sakta hai. Sintered glass crucible glass ka hai jis mein porous glass disc pehle se lagi hai, is liye tayyari nahi chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke sawal (d) mein 'Different shade' chhapa hai; matlab 'Differentiate' (farq batayein) hai.
Summary (khulasa)

items: Filtration: ek component solvent mein hal karein, phir filter karein; jo hal nahi hota woh residue ban kar rukta hai, filtrate guzar jata hai (ret aur namak).
Filter media: 60-degree funnel mein paper cone (aahista), fluted paper (tez), Gooch crucible (suction, tez garmi; HCl aur KMnO₄ ke liye asbestos), sintered glass crucible (tayyari nahi).
